title: Satori configuration package
description: Scaffolds a Nuxeo Marketplace package that contributes Layer 0 (bootstrap) and Layer 1 (manifest) configuration to Nuxeo Satori, with a build target that validates the JSON and produces the installable zip.

name.description: Marketplace package name, kebab-case, at most 128 characters. Also the directory, the Nx project name and the fragment name. Renaming it later is a different package to Nuxeo.

owner.description: Owner prefix for the Nuxeo component and bundle, as in <owner>.config.<name>. Component names must be unique on a server.

title.description: Human-readable name: the Marketplace title, and the starter's applicationTitle. Defaults to the name in title case.

vendor.description: Vendor shown in the Marketplace listing. Defaults to the title.

version.description: Package version. Nuxeo installs a higher version as an upgrade.

presales.description: Add a presales block: preset switching on, and one example preset a demo URL selects with ?preset=<name>.

directory.description: Parent directory for the package: a relative path of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', no part starting with '-'. It goes into the build command unquoted.

force.description: Overwrite the generated files if the package already exists. For the loop of editing a template and regenerating.
